Name: Paltiel, Son of Azzan
Summary: Paltiel, Son of Azzan was the prince of Issachar appointed to divide the land of Canaan by inheritance among the tribes.
KeyStory: Paltiel was named by the LORD, with Eleazar and Joshua, to apportion the promised land to the nine and a half tribes.
LifeLesson: Dividing what God gives takes honest hands.
